due.title: Week 2 note
due.line: Week 2 note · two minutes, your own words

prompts.heading: 1. What did the controls cost?
prompts.hint: Did having Higher · Lower · Again there (or waiting for them at the end) take attention away from the exercise or the briefing? When?

prompts.heading: 2. When I didn't steer
prompts.hint: Think of a moment you could have pressed something and didn't. Why not? For example: it was fine as it was, my hands were busy, I didn't think of it, I didn't trust it to help, or I'd stopped listening.

prompts.heading: 3. When I did steer
prompts.hint: Did what came next match what you meant by the press? Was the line or the spoken cue enough to know it registered?

prompts.heading: 4. Landed / Didn't land
prompts.hint: What did "landed" mean to you this week? Did that change from week to week?

prompts.heading: 5. Anything that felt wrong
prompts.hint: A claim that seemed lost or added when the level changed, a seam you heard, a repeat, the wrong sentence replayed, or a week label that didn't match.
